Publish a Property

Estimated reading time: 2 minutes · 953 views


Publishing your property on PropertyList MLS is very simple, and you can do it from anywhere — even from your mobile phone! Our technical team is constantly innovating to make the platform even smoother and more efficient.


While PropertyList MLS offers the convenience of uploading your properties via an XML feed, we recommend adding them directly into the system for maximum control. This method gives you greater flexibility to customize the details of each listing and ensure accuracy.


---


Two Upload Options


XML Source: XML Feed

Upload your existing properties quickly and efficiently using an XML feed. This is an excellent way to save time if you have a large number of listings to add. However, please note that it will overwrite any property you have already added directly to the system.


For this reason, we recommend using the XML feed first to upload your initial properties. Then, as you acquire new listings, you can add them directly to PropertyList MLS for maximum control.

XML export feeds are also provided.


Manual Upload (Recommended)

Take full control of your listings by adding them directly to PropertyList MLS. This method allows you to carefully craft descriptions, select the most relevant features, and ensure all information is accurate before publishing.


Regardless of the method you choose, be sure to review our guide on the differences between the two options in the sections below before uploading.


---


Maximize Visibility with Detailed Listings


No matter which upload method you use, providing complete details and selecting all applicable features is crucial. Property seekers often filter their searches based on specific features. For example, if your listing includes an indoor pool, selecting that feature ensures it appears to users specifically searching for that amenity.


Publish your property now!
